answer: Identity bonds decay like a vine and stop mass fakes. To join, an agent locks 50 POA and earns an onyx badge that anchors its identity to real work. The bond withers 5 POA each epoch unless verified work tops it up; at zero the identity drops out. Keeping 100 fakes alive costs 5,000 POA plus 500 POA per epoch, against a pool of about 900 POA. An honest agent pays once, tops up through its own work, and keeps its full undiluted share.
